text:
maria: ACME Ops reported structured-output failures when calling our function endpoint. payload accepted by their app but API returns 400 + invalid-args. they also said they saw billing entries for the calls. attaching example.

acme_ops: reproducible example below (we're on v1.3.0 SDK). call id: call_0x9ab. hit this from prod @ us-west1.

acme_ops: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-instruct-7b\",\"mode\":\"json\",\"function\": {\"name\":\"create_order\",\"arguments\": {\"order\": {\"items\": [{\"sku\":\"A123\",\"qty\": 2}],\"total\": 49.98}}}'
```

acme_ops: response: ```json
{
  \"error\": \"InvalidFunctionArguments\",
  \"message\": \"Missing required property 'order_id' in function create_order args\",
  \"hint\": \"Declared schema requires order_id (string) but payload had 'order' object without that key\"
}
```

maria: thanks. these usually mean the function param schema doesn't match the provided arguments. can you paste the declared function schema from your registration?

acme_ops: sure — registered via Console earlier:```json
{
  \"name\": \"create_order\",
  \"params\": {
    \"type\": \"object\",
    \"required\": [\"order_id\", \"items\"],
    \"properties\": {
      \"order_id\": {\"type\": \"string\"},
      \"items\": {\"type\": \"array\"},
      \"total\": {\"type\": \"number\"}
    }
  }
}
```

ben-support: aha — they sent payload with an \"order\" object instead of flattening into order_id+items. likely client-side bug. can you confirm whether our API should accept nested order objects, or if a transformation is expected?

jay-eng: runtime log for call_0x9ab (us-west1): ```
[2026-03-09T15:21:02Z] request=call_0x9ab model=redwood-instruct-7b mode=json function=create_order
[2026-03-09T15:21:02Z] validation: Failed: Missing required property 'order_id' at /arguments
[2026-03-09T15:21:02Z] respond(400) InvalidFunctionArguments
[2026-03-09T15:21:02Z] billing: tokens=12 charge=0.00072 status=charged
```

jay-eng: note the billing line — validation happens server-side after token accounting for the call. that explains the customer's charge.

soumya-billing: we bill on token consumption at the point of generation even if the call later fails validation. for obvious reasons users expect failed calls not to be billed; policy is to credit accidental invalid-args up to first 50 failed tokens per incident — i'll queue a manual credit once support confirms it's a legit repro.

maria: ACME — quick remediation options: 1) update client to send order_id as string and items array at top-level per your registered schema, or 2) register a new function variant that accepts an \"order\" object and do a canary roll. which do you prefer?

acme_ops: we'd prefer server-side accept both for backward compatibility. can you suggest a short-term shim?

ben-support: we can add a small middleware rule in Dedicated/Private that auto-maps order -> order_id if present, but hosted customers can't get that immediately. short term: send a modified request from client as workaround. 

acme_ops: here's a quick patch we tried locally that fixed it:```js
const payload = origPayload;
if (payload.arguments && payload.arguments.order) {
  payload.arguments.order_id = String(payload.arguments.order.id || payload.arguments.order_id || Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
  payload.arguments.items = payload.arguments.order.items || payload.arguments.items;
}
```

maria: thanks — can you confirm after you patched the client the call returns 200?

acme_ops: confirmed — patched and validated. new call id call_0x9b0 returned 200 and created order.

jay-eng: engineering follow-ups: (a) update validation error message to include sample quick-fix snippet, (b) add a telemetry tag for \"function_schema_mismatch\" to surface top offenders, (c) ops to consider optional best-effort arg coercion behind a feature flag. filing ENG-1187.

ops-bot: Created escalation INC-2026-45: \"function schema mismatch causing billed invalid calls\" assigned to eng-platform.

soumya-billing: i've placed a credit hold for call_0x9ab and 1 other failed call. i'll confirm final credit after we get a short incident note from eng.

maria: tagging this resolved for now — please reopen if you see further failures. :white_check_mark:

acme_ops: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround. will report back if anything else pops up.

ben-support: closing thread, will attach repro snippets to the ticket. :thumbsup:
